intent: clean up a bookmarks HTML file that Edge exported: remove exact duplicates, fold similar URLs as the person chooses, sort loose bookmarks into folders, and write a new file to import

in.name: file
in.text: the bookmarks HTML file that Edge exported (Settings, Favorites, Export favorites)

out.text: the path of the new bookmarks file and of its report

rules.label: Folder for the work of each run
rules.note: relative to the tool folder; one sub-folder for each run, with the choices and the sorted batches. Not in version control

rules.label: Folder for the new bookmarks file
rules.note: relative to the tool folder; the export stays where it is

rules.label: Leave the favorites bar alone
rules.note: a bookmark directly on the favorites bar is a shortcut that the person put there: it is never removed, grouped or moved

rules.label: Tracking parameters to ignore
rules.note: a name that ends with _ is a prefix. These parameters do not change the page

rules.label: Sites with many separate pages: never group
rules.note: on these sites a longer path is another page with its own content, not a variant. Add a site here to stop its groups

rules.label: Host names of documentation sites: never group
Last parts of a path that name the same page as the folder
rules.note: home.org/index.html is home.org; code folds such a variant when the short URL is a bookmark too

rules.label: Largest group to show to the person
rules.note: a larger group is a site with many pages, not variants of one page; first value, check it on the real file

rules.label: Groups on one page of choices
rules.note: first value; a page must be easy to read in a chat

rules.label: Folders this deep or less hold loose bookmarks
rules.note: 1: the top level and the top folders, such as Other favorites. The favorites bar is left alone (keep.bar)

rules.label: Bookmarks of the same site in another folder that make one likely misfiled
rules.note: first value, set on the test file; a single bookmark of a site in another folder says little

rules.label: Bookmarks in one batch for the model
rules.note: the owner asked for batches of about fifty to a hundred; a small local model loses items in a longer list

rules.label: Retries of one batch
rules.note: after the retries the batch stays unsorted and the report lists it

rules.label: New folders in one batch
rules.note: the owner wants the folders of the file plus a few new ones

rules.label: New folders in all
rules.note: the owner wants the folders of the file plus a few new ones

rules.label: Longest URL that the model sees
rules.note: a longer URL is cut; the model does not need the query to sort

rules.label: Longest title that the model and the person see
rules.note: a longer title is cut in what is shown; the file keeps the whole title

rules.label: Largest share of bookmarks that one run may remove
rules.note: a plan that removes more points at a bug or a wrong rule; the run is held back. First value

rules.label: Check the links (not in this version)
rules.note: the hook for a link checker: it will move dead links to the folder links.folder, never delete them

rules.label: Folder for dead links
The tool may write over an earlier new file
rules.note: off: when the output file exists, the run ends at exists and writes nothing

rules.label: Most visits of one node in a run
rules.note: the pages of choices and the sort batches are loops; a file of many thousand bookmarks needs some hundred rounds

flow.name: Read the export
flow.do: read the bookmarks file: every folder with its path, every bookmark with its title, URL, folder and date

flow.name: A bookmarks export
flow.ensure: the file is a bookmarks file in the Netscape HTML form, with at least one bookmark; the live JSON file of the browser is refused

flow.name: Remove exact duplicates
flow.do: find copies of one URL, ignoring http or https, www, a last slash, a #part and the tracking parameters of dupes.tracking; keep the copy in the deeper folder, else the oldest

flow.name: Group similar URLs
flow.do: group the URLs of one site where one path starts with another; fold the plain variants of similar.index_names; skip the sites of similar.skip_hosts and similar.skip_pattern; cut the groups into pages

flow.name: Next page of groups
flow.do: take the next page of groups that the person has not decided

flow.name: A page waits
flow.ensure: a page of groups is not decided yet

flow.name: The person chooses the URLs to keep
flow.brief: show the person each group of this page: its site and its URLs with their numbers, and the path of the page file. Ask which URLs to keep. Give the person the answers of how: each one is the end of the command

fail.when: keep every URL from here on

flow.name: Apply the choices of the page
flow.do: read the answer of the person; save the choices of the page only when every word is understood

flow.name: The answer is understood
flow.ensure: every word of the answer names a group of the page and a choice

flow.name: Find loose and misfiled bookmarks
flow.do: leave alone the bookmarks that fit their folder; take the loose ones (sort.loose_depth) and the likely misfiled ones (sort.host_elsewhere); cut them into batches of sort.batch

flow.name: Next batch to sort
flow.do: take the next batch that is not sorted, with the folder list

flow.name: A batch waits
flow.ensure: a batch is not sorted yet

flow.name: Sort the batch
flow.do: put each bookmark of the batch into the folder where it fits best. Choose a folder of the list folders. A bookmark that fits its present folder keeps that folder. Only when no folder fits, propose a new folder: give its whole path under a folder of the list, and "new": true; at most {sort.new_per_batch} new folders in this batch. Give the result as a list with one object for each bookmark: {"id": <id>, "folder": "<path>"}. Write each path as in the list, with > between the names. Do not change a URL or a title. When waiting has problems, your last answer failed: fix them

flow.name: Every bookmark once, in a known folder
flow.ensure: the answer has every id of the batch once and no other id, no changed URL or title, only folders of the list or new folders under them, at most {sort.new_per_batch} new folders in the batch and {sort.new_max} in all

flow.name: A retry is left
flow.ensure: the batch was sent back at most {sort.rounds} times

flow.name: Keep the sorted batch
flow.do: save the folders of the batch; a bookmark whose folder did not change does not move

flow.name: Leave the batch unsorted
flow.do: save the batch as unsorted: its bookmarks stay where they are, and the report lists it

flow.name: Collect the new folders
flow.do: list the new folders that the model proposed, with the number of bookmarks and some titles for each

flow.name: A new folder is proposed
flow.ensure: the model proposed at least one new folder

flow.name: The person agrees to the new folders
flow.brief: show the person each new folder: its path, how many bookmarks go to it, and the examples. Ask: may the tool make these folders? Give the person the answers of how: each one is the end of the command

flow.name: Apply the answer about the new folders
flow.do: read the answer of the person; a left-out folder keeps its bookmarks where they were

flow.name: The answer is understood
flow.ensure: every word of the answer names a new folder of the list

flow.name: Dead links (a hook, not in this version)
flow.do: when links.check is on, a later version checks the links and moves dead ones to links.folder; now it only reads dead.json of the work folder, when it exists

flow.name: Write the dry-run report
flow.do: count and list what the new file would remove, fold, move and make, and write the report into the work folder; write nothing else

flow.name: Not too much removed
flow.ensure: the plan removes at most {safety.max_removed} percent of the bookmarks

flow.name: The person agrees with the report
flow.brief: show the person the counts of the dry run and the path of the report. Ask: may the tool write the new bookmarks file?

flow.name: Build the new file
flow.do: write the new file into the work folder and read it again

flow.name: The new file keeps what it must
flow.ensure: the new file has every bookmark that stays, with its title and URL, every folder of the export with its name, every new folder, and every moved bookmark in its new folder

fail.when: the new file failed its check

flow.name: The output file is free
flow.ensure: no file has the name of the output, or the rule permissions.overwrite is on

flow.name: Place the new file
flow.do: copy the checked file to the folder of files.out; the export and the files of the browser stay as they are

flow.name: Written: import the new file into Edge
The person said no: nothing written
Held back by a safety check: nothing written
The output file exists: nothing written
